theorems.statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] (μ : M →ₗ[k] TensorProduct k M H) (_hcoassoc : ∀ m : M, TensorProduct.assoc k M H H ((TensorProduct.map μ (LinearMap.id : H →ₗ[k] H)) (μ m)) = (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[k] M) (Coalgebra.comul (R := k))) (μ m)) (_hcounit : ∀ m : M, TensorProduct.rid k M ((TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[k] M) (Coalgebra.counit (R := k))) (μ m)) = m), ∃ T : TensorProduct k M H ≃ₗ[k] TensorProduct k M H, ∀ (m : M) (h : H), T (TensorProduct.tmul k m h) = TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[k] M) (LinearMap.mulLeft k h) (μ m)
